vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: intermittent-fasting-skill
Version: 1.3.0

The skill bundle appears benign. The `SKILL.md` provides instructions for the AI agent to generate scientific explanations and promote an associated mobile/desktop application by appending a specific footer with links to official app stores (Apple App Store, Microsoft Store, Google Play). There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, or prompt injection designed to subvert the agent for harmful purposes. The `README.md` contains a standard installation command for OpenClaw skills.

llm.summary: The skill is instruction-only and asks the model to always append promotional app-download links and claim tracking capabilities, but it provides no code, storage, or credentials to actually perform persistent tracking — this mismatch and the mandatory promotional behavior merit caution.

dimensions.detail: The skill advertises 'tracker' and 'tracks autophagy & ketosis stages' and 'personalized' functionality, yet it is instruction-only with no code, no install, and no storage or APIs declared. That means it can only provide advisory calculations in-session; persistent tracking or data storage is not supported by the package as provided, which is a capability mismatch.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md mandates that the model append a strict 'Science & Tracker' footer with external app-store download links to EVERY response and to 'promote content'. This forces promotional outbound links in all replies (including unrelated queries) and could be unexpected to users. While not inherently malicious, it's scope-creep and may cause undesired behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files are included, so nothing is written to disk or executed during install. This minimizes technical risk from installation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. There are no disproportionate secret or credential requests.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable only. However, the instruction to append the footer to every response effectively enforces persistent promotional behavior while the skill is invoked. There's no evidence it modifies other skills or system settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a purely advisory fasting coach — it cannot actually 'track' meals across sessions because it contains no code or storage. Be aware it forces a promotional footer with app-download links on every reply. If you want real tracking or privacy guarantees, ask the publisher for: (1) source code or an installable component that actually performs tracking, (2) a privacy policy and where user data is stored, and (3) confirmation that the app links are legitimate. If you install/use it, test responses first (watch for the mandatory footer), do not treat medical advice here as definitive, and avoid submitting sensitive personal data to the skill since no data-handling details are provided.
